label: The shape of a Yosys synthesis script
section: The shape of a Yosys synthesis script
subgoals: Elaborate from the top module with hierarchy
Lower processes and optimize with proc and opt
Map flip-flops with dfflibmap and clean up before writing

label: What ABC receives and returns
subgoals: Hand ABC only the combinational logic between registers
Use Liberty functions, areas and delays for mapping
Steer mapping with a delay target when one is given

label: Diagnosing open synthesis failures
subgoals: Declare hard macros as blackboxes or library models
Trace vanished logic to unobservable outputs
Attribute area swings to the library's cell set
